title.zh: OpenAI宣布AI取得三项科学突破，涉及数学猜想、计算机算法及千禧年难题
title.en: OpenAI宣布AI取得三项科学突破，涉及数学猜想、计算机算法及千禧年难题

current_state.zh: OpenAI announced that its AI models independently proved major mathematical conjectures (including Kakeya and Stein restriction), overturned the exponential time hypothesis in computer science, and produced strict existence proofs tied to quantum chromodynamics and Yang–Mills theory, with the math and CS results formalized in Lean and the physics claims still under expert review.
